description_en: Modifies the name, description, sample rate, and sampling period of a flow log
description_zh: 可以修改名称、描述、采样率、采样周期
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter modify-flow-log-attribute --ecr-id ecr-fu8rszhgv7623c0000 --dry-run false --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --flow-log-name myFlowlog --interval 600 --sampling-rate 1:4096 --description myFlowlog --flow-log-id ecr-flog-m5evbtbpt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFlowLogAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run to check the request without modifying the service resource.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a token from your client to make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The new name of the flow log. The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 流日志的新名称。长度为0～128个字符
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation interval for capturing traffic data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

60

600

Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：

60 
600

默认值：600
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The sampling ratio. Valid values:

1:4096

1:2048

1:1024

Default value: 1:4096
parameters.name: sampling_rate

parameters.help_en: The description of the flow log. The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 流日志的描述信息。描述可以为空或长度为 0～256 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log instance
parameters.name: flow_log_id
